merge.why: USER RULING 2026-10-21: 'For the buckets it could be as many as K=19 with Mavren Fein removed, but I think we should at least make it K=18 with Secluded Courtyard and Unclaimed Territory merged.' Both enter untapped and tap for {C} or any colour for a creature spell of the chosen type (Vampire); Courtyard's extra clause (creature activations) is the only difference.
